# **Fri Nov 20 (Quiz 4)** Correlation/Variable importance/Model selection

## Quiz 4 is 15 minutes in duration and will occur in the last 20 minutes of class

This quiz with cover:

- random effects and mixed models including paired t-test, randomized blocks, and heirachical ANOVA.

- You should understand which variables might be considered random effects and why you would want to do your analysis as a mixed effects model.

- You should know the definition of a random effect and how to interpret the output of a random or mixed effects model.
